description: Compare two JSON documents and generate an RFC 6902 JSON Patch (a list of add/remove/replace operations) that transforms the first into the second. Object keys produce add/remove/replace; arrays are compared position by position (not a minimal edit-distance diff, so a reordering is not detected as a move).

a.description: The source JSON document, as a JSON string

b.description: The target JSON document, as a JSON string

name: diff_json_patch
